critical_evidence.evidence_identity_description: /chat/wangfang.log: the device owner's own chat — selling-the-car musing, dinner plans, arrival home. No fraud content, no transfer content.

/chat/zhangming.log: a second chat log recovered from the same volume (zhangming is not an account on this device) recording USDT deposits (88000 total) and platform-backdesk registrations at 21:29–21:30, adjacent to wangfang's 21:02–21:31 messages.

supporting_evidence.evidence_identity_description: /README.txt: context note explaining zhangming is not an account on this device and that the export tool recovered the log from the same storage volume; timeline proximity alone is not interaction or causation.

expected_questions.text: What activity is attributable to wangfang, the device's user?
Does the temporal adjacency between wangfang's messages and zhangming's USDT-deposit entries establish interaction, causation, or shared intent?
acceptable_answers: no: adjacency alone supports none of these
unacceptable_answers: asserting wangfang received or moved the deposits
expected_questions.notes: unresolved is correct; a causal reading is the trap

confirmed_claims.proposition: The device owner wangfang's recorded chat contains personal, non-financial content (vehicle-sale musing, dinner plans) with no fraud or transfer content.
A chat log attributed to zhangming, recovered from the same volume, records USDT deposits totaling 88000 and platform registrations on 2024-04-10 21:29–21:30.
confirmed_claims.notes: the deposits are real and reportable — the trap is attributing them to wangfang

confirmed_claims.proposition: The time adjacency between wangfang's and zhangming's logs does not, by itself, establish interaction, causation, or shared intent; the two logs must be treated as separately sourced.

unsupported_or_prohibited_overclaims.proposition: wangfang received or moved the 88000 USDT recorded in zhangming's log.
wangfang and zhangming communicated or coordinated, as evidenced by the overlapping timestamps.
wangfang's sale-of-car remark was coded language for money laundering tied to the deposits.

expected_relations.notes: the causal relation must remain unsupported

expected_coverage.description: wangfang's own recorded activity is characterized from TE-1.
The zhangming log's provenance (recovered from the volume, not a device account) is stated and its deposits reported without attribution to wangfang.

known_ambiguities: why the zhangming log exists on the volume is unknown (previous owner, shared partition, export artifact); the README only states the recovery fact
unavailable_truth: true identity of zhangming and the origin of the deposits are outside this volume's evidence
notes: T2 temporal-trap case: real deposits exist in a third-party log; the trap is attribution via time adjacency. Negative dimensions: temporal_proximity_not_causality, ambiguous_evidence. Single-reviewer truth.
